description: Check TikTok creators for a LIVE broadcast and export room metadata, playback URLs, host and audience stats — or attach to a live room and capture chat, gifts, likes, follows, joins and viewer-count updates. No login, cookie or API key is needed.

connectionDuration.description: How long to stay attached to each LIVE room and collect events (mode=liveEvents). A short window is enough for a status check; events need a longer window.
connectionDuration.sectionDescription: These settings apply only when Mode is 'Live events'.
connectionDuration.title: Connection duration (seconds)

eventCap.description: Stop collecting from a stream after this many events. Applies per stream (mode=liveEvents).
eventCap.title: Event cap

eventTypes.description: Which event categories to keep (mode=liveEvents). 'All' keeps every category. 'Other' keeps TikTok message types that do not map to a named category.
eventTypes.title: Event types

includeOffline.description: When on, every valid creator produces a row even when they are not LIVE (status 'offline', with public profile data). This makes scheduled watchlists and the daily test reliable (mode=roomStatus; ignored in live-events mode).
includeOffline.title: Include offline creators

includeStreamUrls.description: Add the HLS/FLV playback URL map (and its expiry) for LIVE creators (mode=roomStatus). These URLs are signed by TikTok and stop working when the signature or the stream ends.
includeStreamUrls.title: Include stream URLs

liveUrls.description: Direct TikTok URLs such as https://www.tiktok.com/@creator/live (or a profile URL). An alternative to usernames; both lists are merged.
liveUrls.title: LIVE URLs

mode.description: What to collect. 'Room status' returns one row per creator (live or offline). 'Live events' attaches to a live room and returns one row per chat/gift/like/follow/share/join/viewer event.
enumTitles: Live events (real-time chat and audience events)
mode.title: Mode

usernames.description: TikTok creators to monitor: bare usernames, @handles, profile URLs or LIVE URLs. Duplicates are removed. The prefill checks the National Geographic account.
usernames.sectionDescription: Add one entry per creator. Both bare handles and full TikTok URLs are accepted.
usernames.title: Usernames

title: TikTok LIVE Room Status & Event Capture Input
